summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running anything, per instructions. Changes: monai/data/grid_dataset.py adds PatchIter (prepends a whole-channel entry to patch_size, validates mode via NumpyPadMode, delegates to iter_patch) and reworks GridPatchDataset to (dataset, patch_iter, transform=None, with_coordinates=True), with np.ceil worker partitioning, per-patch apply_transform(map_items=False), and NotImplementedError("image dataset must implement `len()`.") when length is unavailable; math import removed; PatchDataset docstring uses float. monai/data/utils.py: iter_patch yields (patch view, int coords [start, stop] per dim in unpadded frame), docstrings updated, set_rnd skips "__"-prefixed attributes. monai/data/__init__.py exports PatchIter. docs/source/data.rst gets a PatchIter autodoc entry after GridPatchDataset. New tests/test_grid_dataset.py has TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape, test_loading_array (single-process and non-Windows two-worker blocks with pinned values), and an extra test_missing_len. Choices: both test images are np.arange(16, dtype=float).reshape(1,4,4); the class docstring example prints shapes only; both len() TypeError and NotImplementedError map to the specified error. Not verified: no tests, imports, or lint were run; the pinned RandShiftIntensity values in test_loading_array are unconfirmed and may fail. Next step: run pytest tests/test_grid_dataset.py. Lines over 120 characters in utils.py at get_valid_patch_size docstring predate this change. Nothing committed.
